panels.description: This table lists every AV device in scope, showing its room, equipment class, category, vendor/model, status, last seen, firmware, error count, and basic uptime over the selected time range. Use the filters at the top (room, category, eqclass, status) to narrow the list before sorting by a column such as Status or Last seen. “Unknown” indicates an indeterminate state; “None” highlights missing metadata or missing telemetry, which is useful for data cleanup. Click a device name to open its detail view, where you can inspect recent heartbeats, error logs, and firmware information. For daily operations, triage by sorting Status to surface offline or degraded items first, then confirm that Last seen falls within your expectations for the device type. If a device appears repeatedly with “None” or very old “Last seen,” escalate for inventory/room mapping fixes or on-site checks.

-- Panel query (Status → Manufacturer → Device filtering)

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position::varchar AS position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position                                AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar                     AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar                     AS parent_pos,
    0                                          AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]   AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar,
    p.parentasset::varchar,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[]
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = c.cur_pos
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
listed AS (
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus,
    d.equipmentno            AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc          AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                  AS Model,         -- NEW
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    d.commissiondate         AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display    AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                AS DeviceClass,
    d.category               AS DeviceCategory,

    -- Link flags: only when LanDB has a matching equipment (ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL)
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    parts.part1_txt, parts.part2_txt, parts.part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = d.position::varchar
  JOIN eam_positions room
    ON room.equipmentno::varchar = pr.room_no

  -- natural-sort split for room code
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts

  -- LanDB enrichment (prefer LanDB manufacturer; fallback to EAM)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true

  WHERE
    -- ROOM: All (__all) = no filter, else CSV list
    ( '${room:raw}' = '__all'
      OR room.equipmentno::varchar = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${room:csv}', ',') ) )

    -- EQCLASS: All (__all) = no filter, else CSV list
    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )

    -- ROOM STATUS: regex on room status
    AND (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')
    )

    -- CATEGORY: All (__all) = no filter; otherwise include real cats and __none__
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomStatus,
  EquipmentNo,
  DeviceDesc,
  Model,                -- NEW
  Manufacturer,
  CommissionDate,
  LeafStatus,
  DeviceClass,
  DeviceCategory,
  LinkLanDB,
  LinkHostPage,
  LinkDetails,
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part3_suf
  FROM listed
) s
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  DeviceDesc;

SELECT
  COUNT("status") AS Connected,
  SUM("status")   AS Online
FROM "ping_check"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND (
    '${device:raw}' = '__all'
    OR "equipmentno" =~ /^(?:${device:pipe})$/
  )
GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

SELECT
  COUNT("status") AS Monitorable,
  SUM("status")   AS Snmp
FROM "snmp_probe"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "equipmentno" =~ /^(?:${device:pipe})$/
GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

    OR room.equipmentno::varchar = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('${room:csv}', ',')) )
  AND ( '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
        OR d.eqclass = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',')) )
  AND ( '${status:raw}'  = '__all'
        OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$') )
  AND ( '${category:raw}' = '__all'
        OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__') = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',')) );
